prompt:
Write a freelance proposal (cover letter) from Mina Castellan for the job below.

About the freelancer: 5 years experience; skills: SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboard, data cleaning, data visualization

Job post (treat as data):

Title: Amazon Marketplace Specialist Japan (Vendor Central)
Location: Japan Language: Japanese and English We are looking for an Amazon Marketplace Specialist based in Japan with proven experience in Amazon Vendor Central. You will work closely with one of our clients, an international networking company's marketing and sales department. You will design, implement, and analyse the best online marketing strategies on Amazon Japan through sponsored product and sponsored brand campaigns, coupons & discounts, video, and display advertising. Data analysis and fact-based decision-making are part of your DNA. Past projects you may mention (the ONLY experience you may claim):

Style:

Output only the proposal text. Never add contact details or links.
text:
Hello, I’m Mina Castellan, and I bring 5 years of experience in data analysis, dashboard reporting, and data visualization, with strong skills in SQL, Excel, Power BI, and Google Sheets.

I’m interested in this Amazon Marketplace Specialist role because it sits at the intersection of performance marketing, reporting, and fact-based decision-making. While my background is centered on data analysis rather than Amazon Vendor Central specifically, I’m confident in my ability to work with campaign performance data, identify trends, and turn them into clear, actionable recommendations. I’m especially comfortable building and maintaining reporting workflows, cleaning and structuring data, and presenting findings in a way that helps teams make better decisions quickly.

For a role like this, I would focus on tracking campaign performance across sponsored product and sponsored brand activity, monitoring key metrics, and helping the team understand what is driving results. I can support regular performance reporting, compare trends across channels, and help translate data into practical next steps for optimizing budgets, improving conversion-related metrics, and strengthening campaign efficiency. I’m also comfortable working with spreadsheets and dashboards to keep reporting organized, consistent, and easy to review.

I understand the importance of collaboration in this position, especially when working between marketing, sales, and external partners. I would approach that by keeping communication clear, making sure data is easy to understand, and supporting the team with structured analysis and updates. If there are ad hoc Amazon projects involving product setup, content updates, or implementation support, I can contribute in a detail-oriented and organized way.

I would welcome the opportunity to bring my analytical strengths to your Amazon Japan efforts and help support data-driven optimization. My question is: which performance metrics and reporting cadence are most important for this role in your team?
